purpose: Teach: キャロル/スクルージ/兵衛/モモ/ポップス/社民党/アントニオ/ピエール

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクリスマス・キャロルの本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you A Christmas Carol.
lines.style: Warm announcement, gentle lift on the boy's name. Pleased about the father-son moment ahead. Relaxed pace, natural cadence of a mother sharing good news with her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスクルージのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Scrooge documentary with Dad!
lines.style: Bright immediate energy, genuine excitement without performing it. Quick tempo on the first sentence. Small, real laugh underneath. Pride in sharing what he did with Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「兵衛」って古い呼び名を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father taught you that old name—Heibei, wasn't it?
lines.style: Soft, slightly wondering tone. A pause before the old name, like she's remembering it herself. Gentle approval of the moment. Reflective, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとモモのケーキ食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I ate peach cake together!
lines.style: Earnest, unguarded happiness. Bounces slightly on the shared memory. Simple, direct delivery—no flourish needed. Small satisfied smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが懐かしいポップスを流して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father played some old pop songs for you.
lines.style: Nostalgic softness. Slight wistfulness—she's thinking of the melody, the moment. Slower, almost sighing quality. Gentle wonder at the gift of that memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと社民党のニュース観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the news about the Social Democratic Party with Dad.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no particular inflection. Child reporting what happened without editorializing. Straightforward, observant tone. Mild curiosity, not excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアントニオ・バンデラスの映画を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching an Antonio Banderas film.
lines.style: Casual observation, slightly amused. Small smile in her voice at the specific detail. Light, offhand delivery—she's noting what he was doing. Not particularly invested but noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとピエール・ローティの小説の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, we looked at a picture book based on a Pierre Loti novel with Dad.
lines.style: Pleased, proud of remembering the author's name. Warm closure to the list of shared moments. Soft, satisfied ending—the 'we' carries contentment. Slight trailing warmth.
